from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u005/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=program_dir/'task-3164d06d.py'
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = []
    for br in range(0, len(grid), 3):
        row = []
        for bc in range(0, len(grid[0]), 3):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(br, br + 3) for c in range(bc, bc + 3) if grid[r][c] != 5]
            row.append(Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0] if cells else 5)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(path), 'exec'))
